name: 3d-geospatial-com
description: 3D Geospatial & Digital Twin Automation — static site built with Eleventy, deployed to Cloudflare Pages.

scripts.qa: node scripts/check-codeblocks.mjs && node scripts/check-meta.mjs && node scripts/check-external-links.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy _site --project-name=3d-geospatial-com --branch=main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy _site --project-name=3d-geospatial-com --branch=preview --commit-dirty=true
